scripts.text:
[KVM Officer]
Good Game.
May the glory of KVM be with you.
You aquire the winning points: 5
scripts.translation:
[KVM军官]
打得漂亮。
愿KVM的荣耀与您同在。
您获得了5点胜利积分。

scripts.text:
[KVM Officer]
I am so sorry.
I wish you better luck next time.
You aquire the losing points: 1
scripts.translation:
[KVM军官]
真遗憾，祝您下次好运。
您获得了1点失败积分。
